title: Vitrectomy (for retinal detachment and bleeding)
what: Through tiny openings, the surgeon removes the vitreous, the clear gel inside the eye. The retina is repaired, and the eye is filled with fluid, gas, or oil.
why: For retinal detachment, bleeding inside the eye, a hole in the center of the retina, and other conditions.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; sometimes you stay in the hospital for 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
Diabetes, heart disease, and blood pressure
If you plan to fly or travel to the mountains
If you had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and a checkup with a general doctor. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: If you have general anesthesia, you usually do not eat from the evening before. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Head position
prepare.text: After surgery, you may need to keep your head in a special position. Get pillows ready at home.

steps: An IV line is placed in your vein
You get numbing medicine near the eye or general anesthesia
The surgeon makes a few tiny openings
The vitreous is removed and the retina is repaired
The eye is filled with fluid, gas, or silicone oil
feel: During surgery, it does not hurt
Afterward, the eye feels heavy and sandy
Vision is very blurry at first, especially if there is gas in the eye
after: Keep your head in the position the doctor told you, exactly
While there is gas in the eye, do not fly or go up into the mountains
Do not lift heavy things or bend over suddenly
If oil was left in the eye, it is removed later in a second surgery
red_flags: Severe eye pain, nausea, or vomiting: see a doctor right away
Pus from the eye or severe eyelid swelling
A severe headache with eye pain: call emergency services

faq.q: Why do I need to lie face down?
faq.a: The gas bubble floats up and presses on the retina. This helps it reattach.

faq.q: When will my vision come back?
faq.a: Gradually, over weeks and months. A lot depends on the condition of the retina.

reminders.text: Eye surgery tomorrow. Bring your documents, your list of medicines, and someone to go with you. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
